title: Proxmox Console
description: Operator-visible console assignment settings. Credential broker grants, credential rule IDs, and session context are injected when a user opens a console session.

credential_broker.description: Injected credential broker grant for the scoped console credential rule.

credential_rule_id.description: Network credential rule that authorized this console plugin assignment.

api_token_secret_ref.description: Internal Proxmox API token reference resolved into api_token only in scoped agent runtime config.

credential_secret.description: Injected decrypted SSH console credential payload resolved from the scoped credential rule.

console.description: Injected non-secret console session context from the agent streaming runtime.

target.description: Injected target selected from ServiceRadar plugin inputs. Agent-local override for command-line testing only.

ssh.description: Agent-local SSH credential fallback for customers that keep console credentials off the control plane. Central settings should use credential broker grants instead.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Allow TLS verification bypass for Proxmox API console transports.
